package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	if len(args) != 1 || args[0] != "-version" {
		args = append([]string{"-db", os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_DATABASE")}, args...)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_REAL_GOVULNCHECK"), args...)
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	err := cmd.Run()
	if err == nil {
		return
	}
	var exited *exec.ExitError
	if errors.As(err, &exited) {
		os.Exit(exited.ExitCode())
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(2)
}
